description: Limits each user's local SQLite database while preserving core conversation context. It enforces after recycling a session and during scheduled maintenance; under pressure it evicts old tool outputs first, reclaims rebuildable memory indexes, then removes session families from binned to normal to pinned.
note: Scheduled maintenance starts five minutes after app startup and repeats at the configured interval. Tool and memory percentages are preferred shares; unused space may be borrowed until pressure occurs. Running sessions and a freshly recycled family are protected.

settings.label: Maximum database size (MB)
settings.hint: Default: 100 MB per user. Cleanup preserves messages by reclaiming tool payloads and rebuildable memory data before deleting sessions.

settings.label: Tool output share (%)
settings.hint: Preferred share for tool requests and stored results. Old results are replaced by a replay-safe storage notice when cleanup runs.

settings.label: Agent memory share (%)
settings.hint: Preferred share for memory pages and vector indexes. Rebuildable chunks are reclaimed before memory pages; conversation storage receives the remaining percentage.

settings.label: Maintenance interval (hours)
settings.hint: Checks every user database on this interval, even when no session is recycled. The first check starts five minutes after the app starts.
